result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and subsequent deletion certification. It leaves the existing termination-payment terms unchanged and adds only the required exit obligations. Drafting is professional, though placement within the termination-payment subsection is somewhat awkward and using the agreement’s defined term for Customer Data would be cleaner.
